title: Practice 7: Setting out: пойти, поехать — and сходить, съездить

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.q: Ты не ___ (поехать — to set off (by vehicle)) в Боснию на каникулы.
exercises.why: The future perfective (поеду, поедешь) belongs to the 1st -е- type of conjugation. — DLI, Lesson 54.  ·  Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
exercises.prompt: You aren't going to Bosnia on vacation.
exercises.context: The future perfective (поеду, поедешь) belongs to the 1st -е- type of conjugation.

exercises.q: Я ___ (сплавать — to swim there and back) до другого конца бассейна.
exercises.why: The past perfective (полетел, -ла, -ло, -ли) is formed in a regular way. — DLI, Lesson 55.  ·  Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
exercises.prompt: I swam to the other end of the pool and back.
exercises.context: The past perfective (полетел, -ла, -ло, -ли) is formed in a regular way.

exercises.q: Я всегда хотел ___ (поездить — to ride about for a while) по Европе.
exercises.why: The prefix "по-" when added to the "repeated function" verbs — ходить, ездить, летать — forms perfective verbs: походить, поездить, полетать. — DLI, Lesson 63.  ·  Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
exercises.prompt: I've always wanted to travel through Europe.
exercises.context: The prefix "по-" when added to the "repeated function" verbs — ходить, ездить, летать — forms perfective verbs: походить, поездить, полетать.

exercises.q: Неискренний подарок впрок не ___ (пойти — to go, set off (on foot)).
exercises.why: The perfective verbs пойти and поехать denote a single action with emphasis on the completed start. (Similar to the English concept of "to leave for"; "to set out"). *Где старшина? Он пошёл в штаб.* — DLI, Lesson 54.  ·  Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
exercises.prompt: One won't profit by an insincere gift.
exercises.context: The perfective verbs пойти and поехать denote a single action with emphasis on the completed start.

exercises.q: Я сегодня ___ (сходить — to go and come back (on foot)) в океанариум.
exercises.why: Он сходил к другу.* я — пойду́ — пое́ду — полечу́ — побегу́ — понесу́ — повезу́. ты — пойдёшь — пое́дешь — полети́шь — побежи́шь — понесёшь — повезёшь. он, она — пойдёт — пое́дет — полети́т — побежи́т — понесёт — повезёт. мы — пойдём — пое́дем — полети́м — побежи́м — понесём — повезём. вы — пойдёте — пое́дете — полети́те — побежи́те — понесёте — повезёте. они — пойду́т — пое́дут — полетя́т — побегу́т — понесу́т — повезу́т.* — Wikipedia, «Russian grammar» (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Russian_grammar#Verbs_of_motion, CC BY-SA 4.0)  ·  Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
exercises.prompt: I went to the aquarium today.
exercises.context: Он сходил к другу.

exercises.prompt: It won't be long before we can travel to Mars.

exercises.why: The past perfective (полетел, -ла, -ло, -ли) is formed in a regular way. — DLI, Lesson 55.  ·  Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: I only meant to buy one gift, but I got carried away and bought half the store.
exercises.why: The perfective aspect of "Going Verbs" is formed by adding the prefix "по" to the actual function verbs ("идти", "ехать", etc.). The perfective verbs пойти and поехать denote a single action with emphasis on the completed start. (Similar to the English concept of "to leave for"; "to set out"). The perfective verb полететь (like пойти and поехать) denotes single action with the emphasis on the completed start. The past perfective (полетел, -ла, -ло, -ли) is formed in a regular way. The future perfective (полечу, полетишь) belongs to the 2nd (-и-) type of conjugation. The consonant "т" changes into "ч" in the first person singular only. Adding a prefix to the repeated function verbs: ходить,… — DLI, Lesson 54.  ·  Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
exercises.ru: Я собиралась купить только один подарок, но меня ___, и я скупила полмагазина.
exercises.context: The perfective aspect of "Going Verbs" is formed by adding the prefix "по" to the actual function verbs ("идти", "ехать", etc.). (DLI, Lesson 54)
